description.value:
When you use Empower Sneak Attack, you can try to steal the knowledge of how to cast a spell from the caster. The DC equals 8 + your proficiency + your Intelligence. On a failed save, you negate the spell's effect, and you steal the knowledge of the spell. You can cast this spell once without expending a spell slot and without material components during the next 7 days. You can also cast it again by expending a number of uses of your Empower Sneak Attack equal to the spell's level. The original caster can't cast it until the 7 days have passed.

Once you have stolen a spell with this feature, you can't use it again until you have finished a Long Rest.
